Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, let's hurry up and go.
Yeah. No point hanging around here.
Hey, if we're going, let's go already.
Yep. So, what are we doing？
Ah, that was fun！ Okay, should we head home？
Um, it's getting about that time...
Sigh, it's this late already. I should get home. Kind of sad, though.
Well, it's getting late. Should we head home？
Yeah. We had plenty of fun.
Yeah. Rinko was thinking it was about time too.
Yeah. Rinko's in the mood to go, too.
Well, we've been everywhere we wanted. Let's go home.
So, um, about what we do next... what should we do？
Since we're here, I'll let you escort Rinko. Now... can you keep your girlfriend happy？
So many fun places, I can't decide. Hey, where do you think Rinko would have the most fun？
So？ Where are we going next？
So, where are you planning to take Rinko next？
What now？ Rinko will follow you anywhere.
So, what now？ If we're going, let's get going.
Where to next？ I hope there's somewhere Rinko'll like...
Um... Where next？ Rinko doesn't mind leaving it all to her boyfriend...
Where are you taking me next？ I can expect good things, right？
What next？ I'd be happy if it's somewhere fun again...
What next？ Rinko doesn't mind, so you decide.
What should we do next？ Any suggestions？
If we're doing this, let's pick a movie we'll both enjoy... What do you think？
What should we watch...？ Oh, warning. No dirty movies, got it!?
Like I would！ What I want to see is...
Hey, hey. Guess what Rinko wants to watch.
Huh. So this is what's playing... So, which one？
Now, what should we watch？ Any suggestions？
What should we watch？ Oh, if there's one you want to see, don't hold back for Rinko.
(Something we'll both enjoy would be best...)
What are we watching？ I hope there's something decent.
Hey... would you watch one more with me？
Since we're here, want to watch another one？
Hey. Rinko wants to watch more movies with you.
Oh, I wanted to see this one too...
Then let's watch one more. Which one？
Hey, want to see this one too？
Hey, hey. Don't the other movies look fun too？
Yeah, sounds good. Looks like you really get Rinko.
Ooh. Sounds fun. This might be good.
Mm-hmm. You know just what Rinko likes.
...You don't get it. Well, I'll go.
Hmm. I'm not sure that's Rinko's kind of thing...
Let's get lunch somewhere. Rinko wants something tasty.
All right, leave it to me.
Let's eat. And where... I'll leave that to you！
Don't complain when we get there, okay？
It's lunchtime already. Rinko wants to eat.
Aren't you hungry？ We could get lunch first.
It's almost noon. Want to grab something to eat？
Rinko's getting hungry. Hey, let's eat something.
Um, want to get some tea？ It's fine if you don't...
Hey, let's get some tea. I'll put up with a cheap place this once.
Rinko wishes someone would ask her out for tea soon～.
Let's take a little break. Get some tea or something.
Want to stop for tea somewhere？ I'm a little tired.
Let's get some tea somewhere. I want a breather.
Hey, we're getting dinner before we go home, right？ It's getting kind of late...
Let's get dinner while we're out.
The sun's going down. What about dinner？
It's about dinnertime at Rinko's house. How's your stomach？
I'm getting kind of hungry. I can still hold out, but... can we eat now？
I'm getting kind of hungry. I can still hold out, but... can we eat now？
We're here. Hey, let's hurry in.
Um. Rinko's got a little more time today.
Rinko can stay out a little longer, you know？
Really？ Then should we go somewhere？
So how about we hang out a little longer？ Somewhere else？
Want to hang out a little longer？
Then want to go somewhere else？
Yeah, that could be nice. Where to？
Yeah, want to stay out a little longer？
Yeah！ Hey, hey, where are we going？
We should get home before it's too late.
But yeah, it's about time to head home.
Yeah, we have to get home.
All right, now that it's decided, let's go.
There won't be enough time for that.
Oh, but there might not be enough time for that...
...Ugh！ You don't get a girl's heart at all！ Forget it, forget it！
